b2-chilecentro-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Between Two Mountain Ranges
b2-chilecentro-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about Chile, and he asks where most Chileans live.
b2-chilecentro-01.prompt: Tell Carlos where the Central Valley lies, putting the place first.
b2-chilecentro-01.target: Entre los Andes y la cordillera de la Costa se extiende el Valle Central.
b2-chilecentro-01.english: The Central Valley lies between the Andes and the Coastal Range.
b2-chilecentro-01.canDo: I can put a place, a time or a quality first to stress it when I describe the Central Valley.

b2-chilecentro-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Means to Go Up the Hills
b2-chilecentro-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are planning a trip to Valparaíso, and she asks how people get up to the hills.
b2-chilecentro-02.prompt: Tell Meg what the funiculars are for the people of Valparaíso.
cues: Say that the funiculars are a means
Say that people go up the hills with them
b2-chilecentro-02.target: Los ascensores son el medio con el que los porteños suben a los cerros.
b2-chilecentro-02.english: The funiculars are the means with which the people of Valparaíso go up the hills.
b2-chilecentro-02.canDo: I can describe the places and ways of Valparaíso with *en la que*, *con el que* and other prepositions with *el que*.

b2-chilecentro-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Strictly Speaking, in Parral
b2-chilecentro-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are reading an article about Pablo Neruda, and he thinks the poet was born in Isla Negra.
b2-chilecentro-03.prompt: Correct Carlos with the exact truth about where Neruda was born.
cues: Show that you are being exact
b2-chilecentro-03.target: En rigor, Neruda no nació en Isla Negra, sino en Parral.
b2-chilecentro-03.english: Strictly speaking, Neruda was not born in Isla Negra but in Parral.
b2-chilecentro-03.canDo: I can show my attitude to a fact about the poets with stance adverbs such as *en realidad*, *en rigor* and *lamentablemente*.

b2-chilecentro-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Before the Planes Came
b2-chilecentro-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are preparing a talk about 11 September 1973, and she asks what Allende did that morning.
b2-chilecentro-04.prompt: Tell Meg what Allende did before the planes bombed the palace.
cues: Say it was before the bombing
b2-chilecentro-04.target: Allende habló por radio antes de que los aviones bombardearan el palacio.
b2-chilecentro-04.english: Allende spoke on the radio before the planes bombed the palace.
b2-chilecentro-04.canDo: I can put events in order with *antes de que* + subjunctive and *después de que* + indicative.

b2-chilecentro-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Although the No Won
b2-chilecentro-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about the 1988 plebiscite, and he asks if Pinochet left office right away.
b2-chilecentro-05.prompt: Tell Carlos that the No won but Pinochet stayed until 1990.
b2-chilecentro-05.target: Si bien el plebiscito de 1988 lo ganó el No, Pinochet siguió en el cargo hasta 1990.
b2-chilecentro-05.english: Although the No won the 1988 plebiscite, Pinochet stayed in office until 1990.
b2-chilecentro-05.canDo: I can grant a point and say what matters more with *si bien* + indicative.

b2-chilecentro-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Central Chile in Review
b2-chilecentro-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are preparing a short talk about central Chile, and she asks when Valparaíso became a World Heritage Site.
b2-chilecentro-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg the year in which UNESCO declared Valparaíso a World Heritage Site.
b2-chilecentro-consolidation.target: El año en el que la UNESCO declaró el casco histórico de Valparaíso Patrimonio de la Humanidad fue 2003.
b2-chilecentro-consolidation.english: The year in which UNESCO declared the historic quarter of Valparaíso a World Heritage Site was 2003.
b2-chilecentro-consolidation.canDo: I can review what I learned about central Chile, from the Central Valley to the constitutional votes.
